title: Calibration Bin Overconfidence Watch
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:calibration bin_name=* overconfident=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(overconfident="yes",1,0))) as matched by bin_name
| eval overconfidence_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - overconfidence_pct
description: Measures the percentage of calibration reviews that end with overconfidence by calibration bin.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which calibration bin are helping or hurting calibration reviews.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `overconfidence` on `forecast:calibration` events and summarize the hit rate by `bin_name`.
visualization: Table of calibration bin with percentage of calibration reviews ending with overconfidence.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how often overconfidence happens for each calibration bin so you can see where calibration reviews go smoothly or get stuck.
